item.title: Why do planes keep circling before landing? The UN has a plan to fix it
item.description: Air traffic delays cost billions and turn journeys into ordeals. Some countries are already proving that better coordination saves thousands of flying hours and cuts emissions – and the UN’s aviation agency wants the rest of the world to follow.
